python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) from Table 4
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # Includes emergency ship construction from March 1941
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: log(E[t] / E[t-1])
years = list(sorted(expenditures.keys()))
log_growth_rates = []

for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    prev_val = expenditures[prev_year]
    curr_val = expenditures[curr_year]
    log_growth = math.log(curr_val / prev_val)
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    print(f"{prev_year}->{curr_year}: {prev_val} -> {curr_val}, log growth = {log_growth:.6f}")

print(f"\nNumber of log growth rates: {len(log_growth_rates)}")
print(f"Log growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.6f}")

# Calculate population standard deviation (using N, not N-1)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population standard deviation: {pop_std:.6f}")

# Calculate coefficient of variation (std dev / mean)
# Use absolute value of mean since it could be negative
cv = pop_std / abs(mean)
print(f"\nCoefficient of variation: {cv:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(cv, 2)}")
EOF

import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) from Table 4
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # Includes emergency ship construction from March 1941
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: log(E[t] / E[t-1])
years = list(sorted(expenditures.keys()))
log_growth_rates = []

for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    prev_val = expenditures[prev_year]
    curr_val = expenditures[curr_year]
    log_growth = math.log(curr_val / prev_val)
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)

# Mean
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)

# Population standard deviation (using N = 8)
n = len(log_growth_rates)
pop_variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(pop_variance)

# Sample standard deviation (using N-1 = 7)
sample_variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / (n - 1)
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)

print(f"Number of data points: {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population std (N): {pop_std:.6f}")
print(f"Sample std (N-1): {sample_std:.6f}")
print(f"\nCV with population std: {pop_std/mean:.6f}")
print(f"CV with sample std: {sample_std/mean:.6f}")
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded): {round(pop_std/mean, 2)}")
